kind: Explanatory contract supplement; product/schema behavior and frozen S07 module bytes unchanged
editor_schema_exposure: Installed schema wind_drag equals the acknowledged frozen I contract exactly; this supplement is a separate evidence artifact, not a new schema field

inputs.U: Nonnegative effective wind speed passed into setcdwcoefficient, m/s

coefficient_law.editor_admission: Refuses if b2-b1 < 0.1 exactly or binary64 b2 <= b1 or b2 < b1+0.1; never edits or clamps speed implicitly
coefficient_law.interpolation: Linear between anchors, constant endpoint values outside; no factor of 1000, percent conversion, radians inference or additional drag-law evaluation
coefficient_law.equal_coefficients: c1=c2 yields that same dimensionless Cd for every nonnegative U in this branch
coefficient_law.implementation_scope: The editor changes declared numeric tokens only. It does not evaluate a wind time series, forecast stress, or certify native input validity.

conditional_stress_law.velocity_route: jawindstressgiven=0; no provided-stress conversion. wxL=wx,wyL=wy when Relativewind=0
conditional_stress_law.effective_wind: If Relativewind>0 the source subtracts relativewind times the top-layer water velocity in Cartesian components before computing U=hypot(wxL,wyL)
required_assumptions: Fixed Rhoair=1.2 for the illustrative numbers; no spatial/computed air density overriding it
No ice drag modifier, no stress-input conversion, no coefficient/spatial override or different drag law
Cartesian frame and correctly bound magnitude/direction windxy uniMagDir with operand O and valid time coverage
Actual retained primitive wind and stress outputs must be checked at their actual recorded phase/time; no inference from process completion
conditional_stress_law.overrides: setwindstress optionally applies ice modification and spatial/computed air density; editor inspection alone does not establish their absence
conditional_stress_law.zero_wind: Under these assumptions U=0 gives tau_x=tau_y=0 for both coefficient tables. Source allocation and forcing update reset primitive stress arrays; fresh controls must independently check every recorded frame, masks and phase.

wind_provider_assumptions.bound_provider: [Meteo] quantity=windxy, forcingFileType=uniMagDir; candidate refuses alternative Meteo providers
wind_provider_assumptions.clock: ecUniInitializeTimeFrame uses configured model reference date; 0..2 minutes spans 0..120 seconds only with the matching explicit model reference/time settings
wind_provider_assumptions.example: direction225 gives +x,+y; it does not produce two negative components
wind_provider_assumptions.interpolation: For interpolate_timespace, magnitude is linearly interpolated and direction uses cyclic interpolation; identical endpoint records give the steady input in their covered interval
wind_provider_assumptions.editor_limit: WND leaf bytes are opaque and retained; the editor does not parse their units, reference date or direction. Independent validation owns these checks.

primitive_output_contract.storage: Writer maps link wind/stress vectors through linktonode2 to cell-centered map output; identify actual variable names, dimensions, units, masks and coordinate frame from the recorded file
substitutions_forbidden: a log assertion in place of raw primitive outputs
primitive_output_contract.phase_gate: No native initialization/update/output phase or tolerance is established by this package check. Independent V must predeclare and then inspect actual clocks and complete recorded arrays, including initial/zero-control frames.

illustrative_predictions.kind: Source-based arithmetic predictions, not observed native results and not the independently authored V oracle
illustrative_predictions.only_input_mutation: First declared coefficient .001 -> .002; second .003 and anchors5/15 unchanged
illustrative_predictions.nonzero_midpoint_change: Cd .002 -> .0025 and tau magnitude .24 -> .30 Pa; +25% under the stated conditions

native_verification: Not performed. This supplement grants no native lease and does not replace scientific V or coordinator authorization.
